sources.excerpt: Colfax Recorders Zephyr Overdrive - Pedal of the Day Reviews Demos Buy a Pedalboard Interviews Contact Navigation Menu Menu Colfax Recorders Zephyr Overdrive Posted By Pedal of the Day on Friday, November 18, 2022 in Colfax Recorders, Overdrive / Distortion | 0 comments --> --> We recently got to check out our first pedal from the team at Colfax Recorders , the Apache Rose Preamp , and were more than a little impressed. Today, we’re venturing down their path once again, as we explore the Zephyr Overdrive. A versatile but easy-to-dial-in drive, this baby blue beauty adds the perfect dirt element to your pedalboard, and fits right in as your new favorite always-on effect… The Zephyr Overdrive with its tweakable high shelf and mid hump can be your go-to dirt pedal. It sits well as an always-on transparent crunch, or as a gnarly distortion . Level sets your output, while Gain gives a nice boost-to-crunch-to-distortion range of dirt, letting you tweak to your heart’s content. Add on to that its tone-shaping 2-band EQ via the Tone and Hump knobs, and The Zephyr can fill all of your ever-changing overdrive needs. Simple and straightforward, but with a lot of sounds waiting to be discovered, the Zephyr Overdrive really does solve any boost or dirt problem you might be having. We’ve really enjoyed these first two pedals from Colfax Recorders – be sure to head to their website for more info and give ’em a follow on your favorite social sites. We have one more left in their current three-pedal lineup, so stay tuned for that one coming soon, and while you wait, head over to YouTube to see just what the Zephyr brings to the table!
